sections.body: Years and calendar months use session dates; month-of-year pools the same named month across years. Recent windows are the last 20/60/120 eligible observed sessions at the requested 2026-10-30 cutoff, with actual latest usable date saved in each source row. They do not imply market data exists through that requested date. Empty calendar periods are no sample. These panels are descriptive stability checks, not independent replications.
